offers_products.reason: Makes paper packing materials (void fill, cushioning, wrapping, Climaliner) and packaging machines and automation equipment.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from paper consumables and equipment; engineering and support come with the products, not as a main service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells packaging paper and machines to businesses, e-commerce and fulfilment operations, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are businesses such as Medline, Helly Hansen and CEWE, plus fulfilment centers and distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Placed dispensing machines drive repeat orders of paper consumables, which make up most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Packaging volumes follow e-commerce and industrial shipments, and customers can cut volume and delay automation purchases in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Most sales are repeat paper consumables bought in small, frequent orders; automation machines are the smaller part.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured paper packaging and machines, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers range from start-ups to global enterprises, including many small and mid-sized e-commerce shippers and distributors.

asset_heavy.reason: Machines are placed at customer sites and paper is partly made by third parties, though it needs converting plants and a machine fleet.

notes: Asset-heavy and large-customer answers are judgement calls. The website text does not settle them.
